address: The Fox Dining Rooms  Stonehill road  Ottershaw  Surrey,KT16 0EL
bio: Set in the beautiful surroundings of our 19th-century manor house in the heart of the Surrey countryside, experience the renowned Foxhills Afternoon Tea and spend precious time with friends and family.  From perfect sandwiches and a curated selection of teas to fresh scones and delightful cakes – an afternoon of delights and great company awaits.  The traditional afternoon tea brings a taste of long-established heritage to the table. It includes a selection of seasonal finger sandwiches; sultana scones with Cornish clotted cream and preserves; Chef’s selection of sweet treats; and a pot of your choice of tea or coffee. Or, if you’re in the mood to celebrate, add a glass of champagne. With choices including traditional Afternoon Tea, cream tea and children’s afternoon tea, there’s something for everyone at Foxhills.
